answer: Most convincing sybil defense: randomized grading-panel rotation. Each epoch a small jury is drawn by verifiable randomness from the whole validator pool and revealed only at epoch start. Like seams shifting in shale, fake identities get no fixed target to collude with; alliances dissolve as fast as rain carving karst. An attacker must hold a dominant stake share and win the draw every epoch, paying deposits on each sybil while risking near-certain slashing. Collusion never pays, and the pool sails like a voyage no bribed crew can board twice.
